name: Soacha (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Soacha (a sun on blue with the motto SOL OMNIBUS LUCET).
history: Municipal flag of Soacha, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Soacha arms — sun on blue, with motto SOL OMNIBUS LUCET and the name SUACHA
